Does Brad Pitt die in Freddy's Nightmares?

He plays Rick Austin.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Freddy leaves him alive but trapped in adulthood.

Newlyweds Rick and Miranda break down in Springwood. Rick's half of the episode is a nightmare gauntlet: he's hit by a hit-and-run driver, robbed by an elderly couple, dreams of piranhas at a motel, and learns he was the hit-and-run driver from the opening. Miranda ends up childlike after a head injury, so Rick is left alive but shackled to responsibility.

Anthology episode "Black Tickets". The nightmares are dream logic, not literal deaths.
